Local-provider evidence only; pin unchanged; no hosted qualification.

Design: TrialBandedObjective.reference now makes its ONLY N factorisation through TrialAcceptedTrialBand.atPreparationLambda on a frozen canonical value-band copy; the reference retains that bundle (ref.factor = accepted.factor), so scoreReference/fullJet and the determinant use one factor instance. TrialBandedMlBackend (new) implements the fixed CoherentTrialMlBackend:
- pointAt validates response length and finiteness, encodes, and mints a CriterionEpoch.
- Node determinant jets are cached at setup from node references, with one Full CriterionReference per node shared by value and jet.
- valueAt uses one value-only reference: raw E plus the scalar logDetK of the same factor, with no D derivatives.
- jetAt uses one full reference: raw fullJet plus the helper jet from the same bundle, minting one Full reference used by both (eq).
- Typed refusals come before numerics; aliased [F, XM] fails as ReleaseRank at bank build.
Work: the 22-field snapshot is unchanged. New out-of-snapshot TrialBandedWork counters cover band N factors, legacy membership RHS, and helper solves/RHS/membership/B-factors/logdet jets charged where the helper runs. Every TrialMlWork is a before/after delta, so helper work cannot be hidden. The duplicate membership solve and small factor are counted twice, legacy plus helper. failures counts refused attempts once each.

Evidence via ROOT/run-sbt.py with the override:
- logs/trial-ml-native-final.log (SHA-256 7222222eea60f752ca2577fcd815e25b29ccc5fc94fa3b120b83df4f8d1cb228; meta f42bf78732b6ab8e396d5e7f0577594559ce15a0c42ca4efeddbdabb3c766ad5; exit 0; 223.3 s; finished 07:03:01Z), JVM and JS: TrialBandedMlBackendSuite(7) + CriterionJet + TrialMlObjective + TrialConditionalSolve + ProfileTrialReadout + TrialBandedWorkReceipt + TrialConstrainedLogDetJet = 55/55 each; firstLevelLaws TrialBandedSuite 9/9 each; scalafimCompileAll 0 [warn]/[error].
- Dense independent oracle (original-time X from design source + compiled basis, independent two-run AR recurrence, K and GLS E via Gale dense, D before nuisance; shares only the compiled basis and Gale kernels): Gaussian 2D J 5.390454716001098 vs dense 5.390454716001093; Cascade 3D J 0.2307853837705317 vs 0.2307853837705327. FD [gE,HE,gD,HD,gJ,HJ] errors ~1e-6 at h=2e-3, shrinking at 1e-3; 3D |H02-H11| of D more than 1000x oracle error. lambda 1e-6/1/1e4 with coincident trials all admitted and matching dense.
- Work witnesses: value = 1 ref, 1 N factor, 2 small, C membership, 0 logdet, 0 derivative. Full = 1 ref, 1 N factor, 3 small, 2C membership, (d+pairs)C derivative, 2 logdet. Nodes: setup 2 logdet, 1 N factor per node; worker node calls 0.
- Unchanged decoder via TrialMlDecoder, sigma2=0.05: scored node energies = J != E; returned energy = J at the returned point; generous fixture budget gives Accepted with terminal evidence bound to coordinates and dataHessian. The E-only legacy decode lands at axis1 0.477 vs J 0.451. The default budget / sigma2=2.5 give BudgetExceeded (existing decoder behaviour, noted not fixed).
- Mutants (logs/trial-ml-native-mutant{A,B,C,D}-r2.log), source restored and hash-verified: separate determinant reference fails 5/7; hidden full D jet in value call fails 1/7; D dropped from values fails 2/7; neighbour node cache fails 2/7. B SURVIVED the first round (logs/trial-ml-native-mutantB.log): helper work was counted only when passed explicitly. Fixed by charging helper receipts to objective counters.
Not covered: executor ML refusal removal, public criterion wiring, full-scope 11/29/14/15/16, science, performance, hosted pin.
